question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Early childhood experiences have a _________ impact on brain development affecting learning, health, behaviour, and, ultimately, productivity and income.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Profound**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Profound" **refers to something very great or intense; of deep meaning. (गहरा)

 
 
• **Example: **The book had a profound impact on my thinking.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that early childhood experiences have a **'profound'** impact on brain development.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Profound**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Basic **(मूलभूत): Pertaining to or forming a base or essence.

 
 
• **Example:** Water is a basic need for human survival.
 
 
 
• **Superficial **(सतही ): Existing or occurring at or on the surface; shallow.
 
 
• **Example: **The discussion only touched on the superficial aspects of the problem.
 
 
 
• The word "perfect" means being entirely without fault or defect; flawless. (उत्तम)
 
 
• Example: Her performance in the play was absolutely perfect.
